requests.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a premium 3D transparent cutout used at 48 x 48 CSS pixels in automotive website navigation.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Preserve its single recognizable object, angle, proportions, realistic dimensional rendering and tidy silhouette. Make a fresh high resolution studio-quality version with flawless materials and clean edges.
Materials and light: rich near-black graphite, polished silver bevels and restrained chrome details; a soft large key light from upper left and subtle edge light. Black must remain legible on a white webpage, with elegant midtone reflections and clear dimensional form.
Composition: one isolated object, centered optically on a square canvas. The complete object including its ring or loop must fit within the same 80% maximum width/height; consistent breathing room on every side. No enlargement beyond the canvas and no cropping. Very subtle transparent contact shadow only.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no background or tile. No text, letters, branding, watermark, additional props, colored glow, or graphic decoration.
Subject: the same realistic modern sporty sedan in the same front-left three-quarter view, glossy graphite-black paint instead of red; silver wheels, smoked glass, clear headlights. Every body panel is black or charcoal; absolutely no red paint. Keep the body and wheel proportions realistic and preserve the same direction.
